title: Most Frequent Even Element
summary: Provide the most common even number from an integer array; if multiple, choose the smallest; if none, return -1.
statement: Provide the most common even number from an integer array; if multiple, choose the smallest; if none, return -1.
constraints: Return the even value with greatest frequency.
Break frequency ties by choosing the smallest value; return -1 when no even value exists.
hints: Count only values divisible by two.
If the frequency map is empty, return -1.
Choose the key minimizing (-frequency,value), which maximizes frequency then minimizes value.
That ordering encodes both the primary frequency rule and the required tie break.
editorial: That ordering encodes both the primary frequency rule and the required tie break.

tests.explanation: Two and four tie at two occurrences, so the smaller value two is returned.
No even value occurs, so the result is minus one.
